title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Loop Output
statement: For a bit string $z$, repeatedly apply the following update $|z|+1$ times: if the first decoded component is empty, leave the current string unchanged; otherwise remove its first bit and replace its second decoded component by that component's image under the total second projection of the pair parser. Then take the first decoded component of the second decoded component of the resulting string, using the empty string when decoding fails. The function so defined is computable in polynomial time by a finite Turing machine.
